newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ABB up 7.5 pct on bonus news.
newsitem.headline: India's ABB up 7.5 pct on bonus news.

text.p: Shares of engineering firm, Asea Brown Boveri Ltd. (ABB) jumped 56.50 rupees or 7.5 percent to 807 rupees at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Friday in early trade, brokers said.
They said the stock was up after the company said on Thursday it would consider interim dividend "and/or" bonus issue at a board meeting on October 17.
ABB shares gained 33.10 rupees to 783 at the National Stock Exchange with 900 shares traded.
ABB Ltd. is a 51 percent subsidiary of Swiss engineering giant, ABB Asea Brown Boveri.
